title: Doping Sn-based 2D Perovskite Semiconductor for Transistors and Thermoelectric Devices
author: Liu, Chen, et al.

steps.title: Check glovebox atmosphere
steps.instruction: Measure the oxygen and moisture levels inside the glovebox and verify that both are ≤ 0.1 ppm (H₂O) and ≤ 0.1 ppm (O₂).

substeps.instruction: Use a calibrated O₂/H₂O sensor to read the O₂ concentration.
Use the same or a separate sensor to read the H₂O concentration.
If either value exceeds 0.1 ppm, purge or recondition the glovebox before proceeding.

steps.title: Store perovskite precursors
steps.instruction: Place all key reagents for (PEA)₂SnI₄ synthesis—including phenethylammonium iodide, Tin(II) iodide (SnI₂), Tin(IV) iodide (SnI₄), and any other materials listed in the key resources table—inside the glovebox and keep them stored for no longer than three months.

substeps.instruction: Retrieve each reagent from its sealed container.
Transfer the reagent to a glovebox‑compatible storage vial or bottle.
Label the container with the reagent name and date of storage.
Record the storage start date; ensure the reagent is used within three months.
